hypothesis:
For multivariate symbolic MSE on uniform [0,1] inputs, normalized MLPs with momentum-0.9 SGD are provisionally preferred over RMSprop when (lr_SGD/3)/lr_RMS≥3 and lr_RMS×T<0.1, at T=256–1024. Do not apply this preference when the SGD model uses SiLU/GELU against a rectifier RMSprop model.

The proposed mechanism is accumulated SGD progress in an undertrained regime, using K1019’s MSE calibration rather than the classification calibration. It predicts E ahead of D here; it does not establish E ahead of B.

History backtest: 3/3 eligible ranked comparisons across two questions favored SGD, with no misses: q_ae5f20 and two contrasts in q_0a12ba. Their proxy ratios were 10–11.1, so they do not directly validate the boundary near this question’s 3.33.

Lab backtest: the unqualified condition won 20/27 comparisons across 15 sets, median SGD/RMSprop MSE ratio 0.832. Excluding smooth-SGD-versus-rectifier-RMSprop comparisons gave 15/15 wins; that excluded subgroup won only 5/12. Below proxy ratio 3, SGD won only 5/31 low-Delta comparisons.

These are architecture-confounded, correlated comparisons. Only two lab pairs matched models, and neither met the proposed condition. The activation exclusion is exploratory and needs independent validation.

```python
class MLPBlock(nn.Module):
    """One hidden layer: gelu(x + Linear(norm(x)))."""

    def __init__(self, width: int, use_layer_norm: bool) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(width) if use_layer_norm else nn.Identity()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(width, width)
        self.act = nn.GELU()

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        h = self.linear(self.norm(x))
        h = h + x
        return self.act(h)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            MLPBlock(width=256, use_layer_norm=True),
            MLPBlock(width=256, use_layer_norm=True),
            nn.Linear(256, 1),
        )

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self.net(x)
```
